writeup.title: fix(stock): prevent race conditions and release holds on failed payments
writeup.summary: Fixes a concurrency race condition in stock reservation by utilizing a conditional UPDATE statement. Also updates checkout so that failed or timed-out payments immediately release their stock holds rather than waiting for expiration.
changes: Replaced separate stock read-and-write checks with a conditional update in `try_reserve` to prevent race conditions during concurrent checkouts.
Called `release_order_holds` immediately inside `record_failed_payment` when a payment fails or times out.
Updated tests to verify that failed payments release holds instantly and that concurrent reservations are safely handled.

functions.what_it_does: Mark the order failed, release its stock holds, and save the payment attempt.
Hold units in one conditional UPDATE; returns False if there is not enough stock.
Hold stock for every line of an order using try_reserve, or raise OutOfStock.
Give back all of an order's held stock unless the reservation leak fault is enabled.

writeup.release_note: Two checkouts at the same moment can no longer both take the last unit thanks to a conditional update, and failed/timed-out payments now release their stock holds immediately.
